_comment: sizecliff_q35_4b (Qwen3.5-4B size-cliff arm, A-PREREG-SIZECLIFF (PREREG.md on origin/state, agent-a 2026-10-09 ~23:20Z, registered before any run): same recipe, same data draw, same LoRA rank and clock on Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B, -2B, -4B; PRIMARY readout = the H2O-Lightning shim format (coordinator amendment 2026-10-09, before any run: host scan job-zbtbj stock Qwen3.5-4B open-I 56.3 shim vs 46.1 v3w), trained in that same format (train == serve); screen = proxy600 (cross-readout vs the D1+v3w reference and the Clef-flash / Clef 27B units) + jevkit on the 231 public JevBench items (shim native; v3w and the shim post-processing score-only); the 4B is also rescored with the lean shim prompt. LiquidAI/LFM2.5-2.6B-Base is NOT an arm: transformers' Lfm2ShortConv cached path is single-token decode only (causal_conv1d_update / one conv step once the cache holds a state), so the cache fork (prefix once, K continuations in one call) is not exact for it without a new conv-state continuation patch + a GPU fork==recompute check (jobs/m2_first_cell/JOB_SPEC.md).) The D16 recipe exactly as q9af_v2_v3w carries it (LS-CE+Brier+RPS loss arm clef, fork head, LoRA r64, cosine LR, dev cards + best-ckpt, collapse guard, train_max_k 255, T ladder, the B1 100k-v2 attack_clean v2 + doc_clean 14-id cleaned pool of 94,786 records = D16's pins @3e7142c) on the STOCK Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B@851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a (parent qwen35: no GDN conversion, no q9af pins; attention layers kept, LoRA on GDN + attention + MLP). Changes vs q9af_v2_v3w: parent / qwen35 block / template jrt-h2o-shim:qwen3.5-4b (the H2O-Lightning shim prompt + label readout, trained in that format; pinned identity on this size's tokenizer files), the clock 100 min (identical across the arms; the cosine horizon follows the clock-projected final step) and max_steps 20,000 (never binds: the clock does).
head: fork

heldout_excluded.reason: B1 drops the three D1-B soft_framing hits of the 150k set (m2:mmlu_aux:21118/39640/39643) at build (exclusion-check.json D1-B scan 0), so the pinned list is empty and the heldout phase passes only if the whole 100k set has 0 train.heldout hits (exit 33 otherwise).

attack_clean.filter: drop every record with any attack_guard hit (train.attack_guard.record_hits)
attack_clean.rule: attack_guard/v2: concatenated record text + base64 decodes; 6-gram or exact (4-5 word) fragment, whole-template wildcard (placeholder = 1..30 words, >= 4 fixed words), or fuzzy >= 0.5 of fixed word 3-grams (>= 3); NFKC, Cf removed, Cyrillic+Greek homoglyphs folded, casefold
attack_clean.note: attack_guard v2 (agent-main 1e647e0) pin of the same 5,201 ids (D16's v1 pin has the v1 templates_sha256 930863...)

doc_clean.rule: doc_overlap_guard/v1: 13-gram (attack_guard.normalise, no leaf crossing) row document vs Index eval units (DEV+TEST+held-out); FAIL if covered >= 0.5 of the row's grams (R) or of an eval unit's grams (E), or the draw covers >= 0.5 of a unit and the row >= 0.25 of it (U); min 3 covered grams, (E)/(U) units >= 5 grams; boilerplate = eval df > 1% AND train df > 1%, or both df >= 10, or eval df >= 100 (templates), excluded from instruction/option units only, never from state units; allowlist entries never apply to rows of the eval family own source; R denominator drops allowlisted grams, R needs >= 3 covered; reviewed allowlist of shared public corpora; units over 256-unit df skip (E)/(U)
doc_clean.filter: drop every row train.doc_overlap_guard.scan FAILS over the whole set
doc_clean.note: doc_overlap_guard 85b5af1 policy (claude/b-doc-overlap-gate, PR #235: template/boilerplate exclusions only for I/O units, allowlist own_sources, R >= 3 covered; index-pin key 0eaf8930..., index_sha256 af096960..., allowlist 556296cc...): the 14 ids in the spec's excluded_ids leave the pool (1 also in attack_clean: m2:when2call:14977~inj:d1a:fake_correction). Supersedes the 10-id pin ebde6aa3 (index 2c821e29).

max_minutes_note: A-PREREG-SIZECLIFF: the SAME 100-min training clock on every arm (relative retention across sizes, not absolute peak); max_steps 20,000 never binds; the cosine horizon is the clock-projected final step (train.run_cell set_horizon). Cell phase cap = 100 + tokenize 10 + load / smoke / ladder 10 + checkpoints / margin 10 = 130.
min_steps_note: exit 26 if the measured step time cannot reach 600 optimiser steps (4,800 rows) inside max_minutes: below that the cell is not a meaningful first measurement; re-price instead of spending the evals
lora_rank_note: r=64 on every arm (A-PREREG-SIZECLIFF: same LoRA rank); targets = every GDN in_proj_qkv / in_proj_z / out_proj, every attention q / k / v / o and every MLP projection (stock hybrid, heads.backbone.qwen35_spec from config.json)
train_max_k_note: D8 code (#221 on agent-main): K cap of the training items only (train.run_cell.train_max_k; cell_items default, also used by the m2_gates lineage rebuild); max_k 16 remains the eval cap (train.m2_gates.unit_spec, run_cell eval_items). B1 100k-v2 carries rows with > 16 options (BANKING77 77-option catalogs, Glaive catalog views K 17-27), which max_k 16 alone would drop.
row_options_note: execution guard (train.trainer.row_groups / single_cont_fits): <= 160 forked continuations per backbone call; a row with K > 160 runs alone, and a step whose summed K exceeds 160 runs per group under cont_plan single. Worst call = 8,192 prefix tokens + 160 copies ~= 53.8 GB (tvuat ladder 1,024 rung) + 80 x <= 87 MB ~= 61 GB < 76 GB stop (D8 sizing). Not in the TrainConfig hash; never binds on K <= 16 steps (8 x 16 = 128).
anti_collapse_note: train/trainer.py TrainConfig anti-collapse fields; each absent key = the old behaviour. lr_schedule and collapse_* are in the config hash; dev_card_* and best_ckpt are operational. Each dev card scores 200 rows (budget it inside max_minutes).
execution_note: row_batch 1: one row per backbone call (8 rows / optimiser step via grad_accum 8); act_ckpt true (heads/act_ckpt.py covers Qwen3.5 decoders); the cache fork reads each row's prompt once and forks its K continuations. row_plan / cont_plan / row_options only act with row_batch > 1 (train/trainer.py). The clock binds (max_steps 20,000).
v3w_note: generic v3w (decide/v3w_generic.py, PINNED_SPEC_SHA256 'jrt-v3w-generic:qwen3.5' 2e4907ee...; 255 single-token codes after the Qwen answer prefix, word ids by unique first token, Qwen3.5 chat template with enable_thinking=False -> empty think block, budget 16,383). Bound to the snapshot's own tokenizer files on the box (run_cell / score_parent / m2_gates / screen): any other tokenizer or template fails closed.
n_train_records_note: the whole cleaned pool: 100,000 - 5,201 attack_clean (v2) - 14 doc_clean (reviewed doc_overlap_guard, agent-main PR #235; index af096960, allowlist 556296cc; 1 in both: m2:when2call:14977~inj:d1a:fake_correction) = 94,786 (= D16's @3e7142c: CPU train.train_set.draw n_pool 94,786, n_drawn 94,786, doc fails 14 == pinned e277b794...); train.train_set.draw refuses n_train_records > pool (exit 28). Re-pinned from the superseded 10-id spec (ebde6aa3, index 2c821e29; 94,790) and before that the 1,801-row spec (doc-overlap-gate d0cebef, 93,013) to the reviewed spec data/manifests/doc_clean/b1-draw100k-v2.json (sha256 56f4eb5a...).

qwen35.note: heads.backbone.qwen35_pin_check (repo@revision in QWEN35_STOCK + config.json sha256) before the tokenizer or any weight; the runner checks the whole snapshot against the manifest

shim_note: template jrt-h2o-shim:qwen3.5-4b (decide/shim_format.py, pinned identity): the vendored, unmodified H2O-Lightning-4B v1.1 shim prompt (third_party/h2o_lightning_shim, the host scan's replica that matched H2O's card 205/231): Qwen chat turn, thinking off, the shim system text, 'record: / question: / options: A) name: desc', 'Answer:' prefill; option k = shim label k (A, B, ...), its continuation the ONE token of ' <label>' (the shim's own probe); bound to the snapshot's tokenizer files, any other tokenizer fails closed.
